# Oil Drilling Services and Micro Strategy Deep Dive Analysis

Report 132 | Published 2024-03-17 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-3-17/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/132.json)

Oil-service value and bitcoin-proxy premiums.

The bitcoin direction and continued Halliburton profitability have evidence, while the profit-recovery premise failed through 2025. The five-year service-stock thesis remains open. Premium discipline is sensible but cannot be counted as a winning switch without matched returns.

**Coverage:** Full text and image inventory read; covered liquidity, wages, bitcoin, Micro Strategy, Valaris, Halliburton and China.

### 132-C02

**Weaker dollar relieves external debt.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Right |
| Type | explanation |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Unhedged dollar liabilities |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | dollar-em-transmission |
| Source blocks | 15, 18 |
| Thesis family | dollar-em-transmission |

For unchanged local revenues, a fall in the local-currency cost of dollar debt reduces servicing burden mechanically. Actual investment performance also depends on hedges and earnings.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Narrow deductive identity only; no empirical forecasting credit.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Deductive assessment:**

- Dollar debt payment D is fixed
- Exchange rate e is local currency per dollar
- No hedge, unchanged local revenue

Local debt service equals e*D. A lower e reduces this cost by D times the exchange-rate change.

**Outcome evidence:**

No independent outcome source is recorded. Any deductive assessment is identified separately.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Next test:** Keep the separately stated five-year proposition open; no retrospective exit optimization.
